name: scheduled burden
operational_definition: Long-run burden of episodic scheduled updating

name: living burden
operational_definition: Long-run burden of living maintenance

name: scheduled reset burden
operational_definition: Fixed reactivation/restart/version/release overhead per scheduled update

name: shared living infrastructure operating burden
operational_definition: Recurring shared platform operating burden; not sunk establishment cost

name: attributable shared-cost fraction
operational_definition: Causal/avoidable fraction of F attributable to current living-maintenance decision

name: portfolio size
operational_definition: Reviews sharing attributable F under equal-share base allocation

name: review-specific readiness burden
operational_definition: Recurring readiness cost independent of eligible-evidence volume

name: scheduled throughput burden
operational_definition: Expected evidence-volume processing burden under scheduled batching

name: living throughput burden
operational_definition: Expected evidence-volume processing burden under living workflow

name: material conclusion-change intensity
operational_definition: Exponential hazard of first material decision-relevant conclusion change

name: decision frequency
operational_definition: Expected downstream decision opportunities per unit time

name: stale-decision consequence
operational_definition: Expected consequence conditional on stale conclusion at a decision opportunity

name: full-staleness consequence rate
operational_definition: Q=DH

name: scheduled update interval
operational_definition: Time between completed scheduled updates

name: living conclusion-refresh interval
operational_definition: Time between completed decision-relevant living conclusion refreshes

name: dimensionless scheduled interval
operational_definition: x=mu T

name: dimensionless living cadence
operational_definition: d=mu delta

name: reset/topic ratio
operational_definition: Reset burden scaled by material-change intensity and full-staleness consequence rate

name: shared living burden
operational_definition: Per-review attributable shared operating burden scaled by Q

name: readiness burden
operational_definition: Review-specific readiness burden scaled by Q

name: processing difference
operational_definition: Living minus scheduled throughput burden scaled by Q

name: average stale fraction
operational_definition: Average probability stale over a dimensionless refresh interval under exponential change

name: optimized scheduled variable burden
operational_definition: 1-e^-x*(rho)

name: general survival function
operational_definition: Survival of time to material conclusion change on dimensionless time scale

name: Weibull shape
operational_definition: k<1 decreasing hazard; k=1 exponential; k>1 increasing hazard
